decisions.decision: X.509 adopted as a format, not as a parser dependency — a bounded hand-written DER decoder for exactly this profile
decisions.rationale: The owner ruling names the hazard: a few hundred KB of exactly the code that generates CVE classes, at the one boundary that must fail closed. A decoder that accepts one profile is smaller than one that accepts all of X.509 and is then constrained.

decisions.decision: Ed25519 verification: crypto.subtle when available, libsodium (WASM) as the fallback
decisions.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-08-09, taken against the standing recommendation of subtle -> noble. Measured: noble 1.348 ms/verify = 99.23% of a chain link; subtle 0.0393 chromium / 0.08 firefox / 0.11 webkit but entirely undefined outside a secure context, including the LAN origin bin/seed.ts advertises; libsodium 0.0887 ms, WASM so no secure context needed, but 314.9 KB gzip against a 168.93 KB total demo bundle. Mitigated by lazy import behind the capability check.

decisions.decision: Phase 26 ships stage 1 only, and everything is gated on the first experiment
decisions.rationale: The roadmap entry states a negative on the fork/exec question changes the whole shape of the work, and requires the two pipeline stages be priced separately.

decisions.decision: Phase 27's anti-placeholder guard lands before the screens
decisions.rationale: A mockup is full of plausible numbers and the phase fails by shipping any of them. Written after the screens, the guard gets written to fit them and 'wired' becomes satisfiable by CSS.

next_action: /gsd-plan-phase 25 — has_context and has_research are both true, so it goes straight to the planner. Success criteria must be one per obligation, minting X509-01..07, with obligation 5 (MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH) recorded as delivered-with-evidence rather than planned as work.
context_notes: No implementation started anywhere — a clean boundary. The session's through-line was that the record lags the tree: it appeared in the milestone audit under-reporting its own closures, in two count-pin guards left red by the commit that broke them, in three UAT items describing finished work, and in roadmap.analyze reporting no phases at all. Expect more; the fix is always to measure the tree rather than transcribe a summary. Two blocking anti-patterns are in .continue-here.md and must be acknowledged before proceeding: quoted history reading as present tense (it produced a false finding that was reported and retracted), and blanket node_modules symlinks in a worktree making guards verify the wrong tree.
